visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair, wearing a brown zip-up jacket over a pinkish-purple button-down shirt, sits in a brightly lit indoor space. He faces the camera directly, sitting behind a grey laptop. He gestures with his hands in an energetic manner while speaking. A persistent green and white horizontal banner is at the top of the frame, featuring a cartoon mascot and text. (2) A cartoon head of a girl with black hair briefly overlays the left side of the frame. The man continues his talk, with various digital icons representing Yahoo and Microsoft appearing and disappearing next to him. The background is a plain white or light grey wall, creating a clean studio-like environment. (3) The man is replaced by a high-tech graphic showing a circuit board with stylized data nodes and icons. This is followed by a static black-and-white portrait of an older man wearing glasses and a formal jacket, with small attribution text at the bottom. The man in the brown jacket then reappears, continuing his animated delivery. (4) A historical black-and-white photograph shows a large crowd gathered in front of a traditional Chinese-style gateway building. The man returns to the screen, gesturing emphatically towards the viewer. (5) A modern-looking video clip shows a dense crowd of people outdoors on a street, many wearing masks and holding placards or mobile phones. They are surrounded by trees and urban buildings. (6) The man in the brown jacket finishes his message. The top banner remains, and a final logo featuring a black cartoon bear mascot and a speech bubble appears in the lower half of the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 最有畫面感的臺灣史. [Slogan]: 動畫+故事！練出 中小學生的 歷史思維. [Subtitle]: 是臺灣人創立了 全球第一個華文搜尋引擎. (2) [Subtitle]: 早在Google之前 台灣就有 蕃薯藤. [Variety]: 那什麼東西. (3) [Subtitle]: 你這個年紀沒有聽過 因為現在 搜尋引擎已經不在了. (4) [Subtitle]: 但是七年級生 或我這年紀以上 一定聽過 甚至用過. (5) [Subtitle]: 它一度在臺灣 是搜尋引擎界 市佔第一的品牌. (6) [Logo]: Yahoo!. [Logo]: 微軟. [Subtitle]: 連Yahoo 微軟 他們想要進軍臺灣市場 都積極想要併購的新創. (7) [Subtitle]: 用今天的話來講 可以說是 創業圈的獨角獸. (8) [Variety]: 那那是怎麼成立的. (9) [Subtitle]: 一般我們想這種科技公司 可能創辦人都會寫程式 或是科技背景. (10) [Subtitle]: 圖片來源: 數位時代. [Subtitle]: 但是蕃薯藤的創辦人 陳正然 臺大社會學系畢業 跟科技一點關係都沒有. (11) [Subtitle]: 圖片來源: 歷史學柑仔店. [Subtitle]: 會搞這個蕃薯藤 很大因素是因為他在 九零年代 是一個非常積極的 學運份子. (12) [Variety]: 搞學運跟做網站有什麼關係. (13) [Subtitle]: 倡議各種社會議題 有一個很關鍵的 資源 就宣傳. (14) [Subtitle]: 以前的媒體資源 報紙 電視 這些資源 都是被有錢人壟斷. (15) [Subtitle]: 沒有錢的人 就很難 去傳播資訊. (16) [Subtitle]: 九零年代是一個 網際網路 開始日盆運動的時代. (17) [Subtitle]: 陳正然就發現 好像可以利用 新興科技作為媒介 來傳播資訊. (18) [Subtitle]: 他就形容 網路就是窮人的原子彈 可以打破資訊壟斷 讓民主的聲音傳播得更遠. (19) [Subtitle]: 蕃薯藤從成立以來 積極地協助各種社會議題 或是社運組織來傳播資訊. (20) [Subtitle]: 雖然現在蕃薯藤已經消失了 也算是見證了九零年代 台灣社運 風起雲湧的一段歷史. (21) [Subtitle]: 搞社運又可以創業 是不是很浪漫. (22) [Logo]: 留言社運. [Slogan]: 告訴你更多相關資訊哦.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and professional clarity at a fast pace. The background features a steady, upbeat lo-fi pop track with a strong electronic drum beat and warm synthesizer pads. The acoustics are clean and dry, typical of a professional studio recording. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect triggers a brief, higher-pitched female vocal line asking a question. The primary male narrator resumes immediately with the same energetic pitch and speed. The background music remains continuous and balanced in the mix. (3) As the narration transitions through various historical points, short 'ding' and 'swoosh' sound effects are inserted at key moments. The music maintains a constant rhythm and major-key tonality throughout this section, providing a positive and educational atmosphere. (4) A low-intensity crowd murmur and muffled ambient chanting are layered into the background, signifying a scene change. The male narrator's voice remains dominant and focused, while the music volume stays consistent beneath the layers. (5) The ambient crowd noise fades, and the male narrator delivers a concluding thought with a friendly, slightly slower cadence. A final digital notification chime sounds as the background music fades out to silence.
